Name: 1 in 10000 Chance for Mangle Jumpscare Every Second
Author: PredatedElk6
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=4]📼[/size][i] [b][color=#cc4125][size=4]What is this all about?![/size][/color][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Verdana][size=2]For my first Stardew Valley mod, I decided to port [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/balatro/mods/856]1 in 10000 Chance for Mangle Jumpscare Every Second[/url][/b], which I originally made for Balatro. Hopefully it does not explode or anything. [/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#6aa84f]1 in 10000 Chance for Mangle Jumpscare Every Second[/color], [/b]this mod adds a rare Mangle encounter that can trigger during gameplay, with a jumpscare that may strike at any moment while you are taking care of your farm;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]A little less calm, a lot more panic[/b][/color][b], [/b]the trigger chance gradually increases over time while AFK, making the encounter even more unpredictable the longer you leave the game running;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]Fully configurable[/b][/color][b], [/b]you can adjust the trigger interval, chance, AFK timeout, jumpscare volume, static effect duration, manual trigger key, and whether the jumpscare should close the game after it ends.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]💡 [/size][b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size][/b][/color]
At the moment, this mod does exactly what it says: Mangle watches, waits, and then reminds you that staying AFK was a mistake. If interest is high enough, I may consider:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Easter Eggs:[/b] expand the mod with hidden references, alternate behaviors, or other small surprises inspired by the world of Stardew Valley and the many characters, places, and secrets it has to offer;[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Counterplay:[/b] add some kind of thematic way to react to or “counter” the animatronic, while still trying to stay faithful to Mangle’s original identity from [i]Five Nights at Freddy’s 2[/i] and [i]Ultimate Custom Night[/i];[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]More configuration options:[/b] add a couple of config entries that could later be reused across my other jumpscare mods as well, such as one that prevents the random roll while the player is in the main menu and another that does the same while the game is paused.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][i][color=#ffff00][b]⚠️ Disclaimer:[/b][/color] [/i][size=2]I won't be responsible for anything else happening due to this mod. Use at your own risk.[/size][/font]

[font=Verdana]
[size=4]🔨 [/size][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]How to install and use[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Be sure to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed, you can check the wiki if you don't know how to do it;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Extract the [color=#cccccc].zip[/color] file in the following path: [color=#cccccc]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color];[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Have fun. :)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#6d9eeb]Want to customize your experience? 🤔[/color][/b]
If you want to change how the mod behaves, go to [color=#cccccc]Stardew Valley/Mods/1 in 10000 Chance for Mangle Jumpscare Every Second[/color] and edit the [color=#cccccc]config.json[/color] file to your liking:[/size][/font]

[code]
{
  "IntervalSeconds": 1,
  "ActivationChance": 10000,
  "JumpscareVolume": 1.0,
  "ManualTrigger": "space",
  "JumpscareCrashesGame": false,
  "AfkTimeout": 10.0,
  "ChanceIncreasePerSecond": 1,
  "StaticEffectEnabled": true,
  "StaticMinDuration": 5.0,
  "StaticMaxDuration": 10.0
}[/code]
[font=Verdana][color=#e69138][size=4][b]❤️ Credits and Thanks:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Inspired by:[/b] Mangle from the Five Nights at Freddy’s series;[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who enjoys absurdly low odds and unnecessary panic.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][i][b]♤ ♧ Enjoy the chaos and let the jumpscare decide your fate! ♡ ♢[/b][/i][/font]
